note: Recorded corrections between scripts/audit-code.py and SRW for Starsiege: Tribes 1.41. The image has no relocation table, so the audit's pointer guesses need these. Each entry gives its evidence.

not_code.why: only reference is 0x631514, inside a table of 16-bit values; decoding there misaligns the unwind funclet at 0x60002A
references at 0x674684, 0x674A84, 0x675044, 0x675444 are numeric table data; 0x600800 is the middle of a call

code.why: C++ unwind funclet (mov ecx,[ebp-0x10]; add ecx,0x4B0; jmp) referenced from the unwind table at 0x6AA430
console command remoteLH_CHMOD, reached only through the command table entry at 0x6C3DD0 (name 0x62E3A0); recorded matches and 1.41 servers call it
console command remoteLH_CHMEM, reached only through the command table entry at 0x6C3DE0

instruction_replacements.why: jnz to 0x52BC65 when DirectInputCreateA fails; the community 1.41 patch overwrote the target with other code, so the branch leads into the middle of an instruction even on Windows. Trap loudly if taken.
instruction_replacements.llasm: ;jnz loc_52BC65 (overwritten target)|and tmp1, eflags, ZF|ctcallz tmp1, hp_trap_52BC4F|tcall hp_loc_52BC51|endp|proc hp_trap_52BC4F|call halopad_trap_unimplemented 0x52bc4f|tcall hp_loc_52BC51|endp|proc hp_loc_52BC51

instruction_replacements.why: remoteLH_CHMOD: jl to 0x401708 lands inside 'mov eax, 0x62E394' (bytes 00 C3, add bl,al) and then on int3 at 0x40170A, so a call with fewer than five arguments faults on Windows too. SRW cannot translate overlapping code; trap loudly if taken.
instruction_replacements.llasm: ;jl 0x401708 (inside an instruction)|lshr tmp1, eflags, OF_SHIFT - SF_SHIFT|xor tmp1, tmp1, eflags|and tmp1, tmp1, SF|ctcallnz tmp1, hp_trap_401697|tcall hp_loc_401699|endp|proc hp_trap_401697|call halopad_trap_unimplemented 0x401697|tcall hp_loc_401699|endp|proc hp_loc_401699

instruction_replacements.why: remoteLH_CHMEM: jl to 0x401312 lands inside 'mov eax, 0x62E394' (00 C3) and then on int3 at 0x401314, a fault on Windows too. Trap loudly if taken.
instruction_replacements.llasm: ;jl 0x401312 (inside an instruction)|lshr tmp1, eflags, OF_SHIFT - SF_SHIFT|xor tmp1, tmp1, eflags|and tmp1, tmp1, SF|ctcallnz tmp1, hp_trap_4012B5|tcall hp_loc_4012B7|endp|proc hp_trap_4012B5|call halopad_trap_unimplemented 0x4012b5|tcall hp_loc_4012B7|endp|proc hp_loc_4012B7
